name: Time-slot view honours the global Merchant Call scheduling rules
description:
Objective: Time-slot view honours the global Merchant Call scheduling rules.
Preconditions: Open Merchant call workflow with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Merchant call workflow.
2. Time-slot view honours the global Merchant Call scheduling rules.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: PRD 6.2: calendar and time-slot view built from the configured rules (no booking).
